family: H_N=family.evaluate on all N actual bits, with LINEAR-output trace-cubic reservoir, group exponent1-beta/2, slice exponentbeta/2-1/2000000 and minimum-source-certificate selection over guarded plans. Uniform P program family.py; empty-witness NP verifier proof.md. Ties first; fallback output0 and t_N=u_N=d_plan=N+1.
theorem: The self-contained trilinear moment/dense-rank proof gives every biased Boolean cubic a constant affine subspace of codimension<=128ceil(log2(2/delta)); whenever its displayed finite guards pass, the trace-cubic primitive outputs floor(w/10000) bits at affine entropy w of2w with error<=2*2^(-w/2000). For each fully guarded accepted candidate p, define original geometry dimension d(p)=1+C(Q-1), actual same-map primitive entropies Theta_j,Hsrc_j and scalar recurrence (SEL1). source_certificate computes u(p)=min(d(p),c_H+1+(S-1)(C-1)) with S=Dtot+max(Y_s0,max_j Theta_j+1)+3. The controller selects least u(p). At its selected plan t_N is the exact POS/DP threshold and d_plan=d(p); t_N<=u_N<=d_plan. These values are uniformly polynomial-time computable from N. C_B2(H_N)>=4N-8t_N+8>=4N-8u_N+8 holds for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length u_N<=2^ceil(D_lin Z), D_lin=425007/100000=4.25007, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(u_N)/Z<=CstarLin<=1062517/250000, CstarLin=inf_(Slin)(w0+X) for the new Slin defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(H_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and this SAME new fixed family has liminf C_B2(H_N)/N>=4. The new family uses changed cubic/grouping maps and need not equal preceding families.
